scope: Support only. No qok classification, association statistic, permutation p or manuscript effect calculation. H/F separate, bathhand2 and starredhand3 on prior shared source loci.
mapping: Retain qualified eight source zero-based origin positions1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15. Do not pack eligible words or renumber around unknowns. A slot is usable only if literal sh/ch prefix, disjoint ending edy/eey/ey/y, and immediate following token readable in same original source line. Missing/final/unknown slots remain unusable. Following identity never retained or classified.
strata: Physical page and exact original token-slot line length, independently per reading. Variable-length adaptation partitions without pooling; qualification only covered fixed-length synthetic arrays, so this is a support audit not end-to-end qualification.
matching: Enumerate105pairings of8fixedpositions; choose by sum n*(n-1)/2 for identical body in both positions on n lines, ignoring prefix type and following identity. Tie same enumeration as frozen synthetic code. Within each chosen pair/body, discordant sh/ch rows give n,k and V=k*(n-k)/n. Aggregate across length strata to page, then panel.
rule: V>=80, >=8positive-support pages, maxpageV/total<=.25. Zero support notestimable. No alternative position search or pooling of H/F.
verification: Reparse every raw line with atlas cleaning, reconcile rows/metadata/shared-loci, retain tokens null slots and explicit exclusion reasons. Check raw/comment/comma/unknown fixtures and invariance to replacing following readable nonorigin tokens. Save every selected group, page and exclusion.
limits: Eligibility sees following readability only. H/F word boundaries may differ and remain literal. Unknown slots are transcription token slots, not claimed exact glyph-space geometry. Failure applies to this fixed-position exact-body test, not absence of manuscript association.
